main.description: Cultural detail attached to an event that the shared calendar record does not carry: who is on, and what is performed or shown. A layer, not a replacement — it references an event by strongRef and never duplicates it. Supersedes com.cultureblocs.venue.lineup, renamed with venue.profile → place.profile so the namespace stays consistent; the shape is unchanged except that `venue` is now `place`. If these fields prove generally useful they belong upstream in the community calendar lexicon, not here.

event.description: The event this describes — normally a community.lexicon.calendar.event record. Pin the CID so the attachment is tamper-evident.

billing.description: Who is on: performers, artists, speakers, DJs. `did` links to a creative profile where one exists.

works.description: Works performed or shown, where the programme is specific about them.

place.description: The place.profile record, when the event happens at a place that publishes one.
